findings.summary: The claim that B40's HTTP-503 session charged nothing conflicts with the persisted session telemetry.
findings.evidence: docs/briefs/B20261126-1418-b45-docs-mixed-os-and-any-agent.loop-brief.md:205 says the 503 halt was "nothing charged"; .vloop/state/runs/B20261125-2207-b40-i156-mixed-os-pwsh/20261125-230701/sessions/011-work.json:3-5 records is_error=true with 6.57856 credits and an estimated cost_usd of 0.0657856 for that B40 attempt, and .vloop/state/metrics/B20261125-2207-b40-i156-mixed-os-pwsh.json:61 includes session costs in the $2.18 total. The intervention at .vloop/interventions/I20261126-005105-copilot-model-endpoint-503s-ended-t4-s-w.md:18 confirms the exit 7/HTTP 503 event but its "no attempt charged" wording is not the same evidence level as the recorded telemetry.
findings.fix: Remove the unsupported "nothing charged" statement, or state the persisted numbers and distinguish explicitly what, if anything, Copilot did not bill outside vloop's estimated-credit accounting.

findings.summary: The URL-shortener evidence is tied to a metrics path no review, work, or verify session in this repository can resolve.
findings.evidence: docs/briefs/B20261126-1418-b45-docs-mixed-os-and-any-agent.loop-brief.md:197-198 cites `.vloop/state/metrics/B20261022-1234-url-shortener-api.json` and says no session here can read it. The ready-copy check `go run ./cmd/vloop brief check .vloop/tmp/brief-check/B20261126-1418-b45-docs-mixed-os-and-any-agent.loop-brief.md` exits 0 but reports `! path does not resolve: .vloop/state/metrics/B20261022-1234-url-shortener-api.json`. This is the only such warning.
findings.fix: Remove the external path and present the literal URL-shortener figures solely as an explicitly operator-supplied measurement, or bring a minimal verifiable metrics artifact into this repository and cite that repo-relative artifact.
